description: Ask what the tracked record shows about a named entity or unfolding event: what changed, what the record holds now, and which sources corroborate it. Not general knowledge or history — grounding is live tracked coverage. 25 questions a day per network address need no key; then each costs one Read on a free key (POST /api/keys). Async — a ticket in ~1s, collected with get_answer.

fresh.description: Force a new synthesis instead of the maintained record's recent answer to the same question (default false — shared state is the default)

observer.description: Optional. The observer this question is asked as (e.g. an observer list_standard_watches names). Recorded as declared on the answer's `replay` block; default "public". A malformed value is named in `replay.declared.rejected`, never applied. Same field as POST /api/ask.

watch.description: Optional. The Watch this question is asked under. Recorded as declared on the answer's `replay` block. A malformed value is named in `replay.declared.rejected`, never applied. Same field as POST /api/ask.

name: ask
